label: Diagram 1
caption: Diagram 1 Tactile paving and an example of its use at an uncontrolled crossing
description: The drawing, titled "Diagram 1 Tactile paving and an example of its use at an uncontrolled crossing," has three parts. The top part is a rectangular outline filled with a grid of thirty-six circles in six rows and six columns, captioned "Blister surface (with 36 domes)," followed by a note reading "Note: Full details of tactile paving are in 'Guidance on the use of Tactile Paving Surfaces.'" The middle part is a cross-section labelled "Dome profile," showing a raised dome of "25mm diameter," a left-hand step height of "5mm," a total height of "10mm," and a right-hand curved shoulder marked "16mm radius." The bottom part is a perspective view labelled "Dropped kerb at an uncontrolled crossing," depicting a trapezoidal patch captioned "Blister surface," with the label "Dropped kerb flush with carriageway" above it, a label on the left reading "Gradient 1:12 max.," a dimension of "800mm" along the sloping right-hand side of the dropped kerb, and a bottom dimension of "1200mm min."
